technology_name: Technology for Production of Coconut Chips
description: Crispy, crunchy, sweet or salty coconut chips prepared from kernels of 8–9 month matured coconuts. The technology standardizes the production process for different varieties of coconut chips, resulting in a delicious and nutritionally rich snack product
applications:
Snack food manufacturing companies
Coconut processing and value-addition enterprises
Healthy and functional food product startups
Food processing MSMEs and agri-entrepreneurs
Institutional food suppliers and export-oriented food businesses
secondary_sector: Agribusiness & Rural Economy, Consumer & Lifestyle Products
